ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Sociology of Sports and Mental Health. Sociological analysis of mental health and illness using case studies from sport; addresses the intersections of cultural sport psychology, sociology of sport, and sociology of mental health. Meets with SOC 196 Course will be a hybrid synchronous meeting at the scheduled time on Mondays and Wednesdays. Fridays will include occasional synchronous Zoom but will mostly be reserved for working on the course project.
